tools.name: google_maps_email_extractor
tools.description: Finds the businesses on Google Maps for a kind of business in a place (for example query "dentists", location "Berlin"), visits each one's website and returns its business emails and phones. Send query with location, or maps_url (a Google Maps search link). Spends one credit per company with an emai

tools.name: website_email_finder
tools.description: Visits company websites (one, or up to 200) and returns each company's business emails and phones. Spends one credit per company with an email or phone.

tools.name: google_search_email_extractor
tools.description: Takes the link of a Google search (from the All or Web tab), lists the company websites it finds and returns each company's business emails and phones. Spends one credit per company with an email or phone.

tools.name: clutch_email_extractor
tools.description: Takes a Clutch directory link (agencies and service firms), lists the companies on it and returns each one's business emails and phones. Spends one credit per company with an email or phone.

tools.name: get_search
tools.description: A search's status (queued, running, completed, stopped, failed) and how many companies it has found. wait_seconds waits until it is done, up to 40 seconds.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: The companies a search found, with website, emails and phones, oldest first. Only the ones with an email or phone unless only_contacts is false. Send next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

tools.name: list_searches
tools.description: The account's history, newest first: every search started on klinio.io, in the Chrome extension, with the API or here. Filters: q (text in its name), status, source, since, until.

tools.name: stop_search
tools.description: Stops a queued or running search. The companies it already found stay.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The plan and the credits left.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: google_maps_email_extractor, google_search_email_extractor, get_results · Public sink: google_maps_email_extractor, website_email_finder, google_search_email_extractor, clutch_email_extractor, get_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: google_maps_email_extractor, google_search_email_extractor, get_results · Public sink: google_maps_email_extractor, website_email_finder, google_search_email_extractor, clutch_email_extractor, get_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_account" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "The plan and the credits left (for a free account, today's and when they renew)." → after: "The plan and the credits left."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
